auto_register_tags: transform a JAX function to auto-populate layer and loss tags by matching computation graph patterns
register_function: register a new computation graph pattern with a tagging function and example arguments for graph matching
match_pattern: find all subgraph matches of a pattern graph inside a larger JAX computation graph
broadcast_merger: merge consecutive broadcast operations in a JAX function to simplify the computation graph
create_digraph: create a directed NetworkX graph from a JAX jaxpr with parameter and array nodes
